sections.title: Exact share split
sections.what: Splits one share into two parts in the ratio of the two weights, using exact fractions so no part is lost to rounding.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the tests check that repeated splits still add up to exactly one. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Zero weights would make the total zero, and the function does not guard against that.

summary: Splits a land share into two parts using exact fractions, in proportion to two whole-number weights.
purpose: Gives the tests a correct way to divide shares without losing any part of the total.
why: Likely reason: exact fractions let the sum stay exactly one, which the property test checks. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Adds the two weights to get a total, then multiplies the share by each weight's fraction of that total. It returns both parts as a pair.
inputs: A share as an exact fraction and two positive whole-number weights.
outputs: A pair of exact fractions whose sum equals the original share.
risks: If both weights are zero, the total is zero and the division fails. The function does not check that the weights are positive.
debug: If parts do not add up, check that the weights are positive whole numbers. If a division error appears, check the weights.
